items.title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
items.summary: Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, the company announced on its Chinese newsroom website, as reported by MacRumors. items.summary: Asked about supply chain shortages, like the ongoing RAM shortage, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in an interview that it's "terrible" to have RAM in personal PCs instead of data centers. items.title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
items.summary: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that publishers can use to opt out of being scraped by AI, as reported earlier by Search Engine Roundtable. items.summary: Google's AI chip-equipped satellite has generated its first response from space. items.summary: Pope Leo XIV says AI systems should be "disarmed," adding that humans "have the responsibility to guide, change and, when necessary, reject its applications." items.title: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web
items.summary: The Wikimedia Foundation is staking out a middle ground in a group of landmark AI copyright cases, pushing courts to legally protect large language models (LLMs) training on copyrighted work - but not chatbots regurgitating that work to users.
